structure.unit: Local Constitutional Officers, Courthouses and Supplies

law.text: Any county or city may appropriate funds for the operation of the sheriff's office. In addition to those items listed in § 15.2-1615.1, counties and cities shall provide at their expense in accordance with standards set forth in § 15.2-1610 a reasonable number of uniforms and items of personal equipment required by the sheriff to carry out his official duties.
